items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: When we had...Buddy and Al Viola and Al Aarons and Grover Mitchell and Leroy Vinnegar had a label together.

ctx.x: I know Cal always does your Christmas cards, the sketches of you on it, that there's really no mistake about whose Christmas card that is. And Cal did a record album cover for you, too, didn't he?
Yeah, he did. When we had...Buddy and Al Viola and Al Aarons and Grover Mitchell and Leroy Vinnegar had a label together. He did our album covers for us.
